newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: IBCA lowers M&R short, long-term ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA lowers M&R short, long-term ratings.

text.p: International rating agency IBCA on Monday lowered both the domestic short-term and long-term ratings of industrial holding group Murray & Roberts Holdings Ltd by one notch each.
IBCA said in a statement the new short-term rating was "A1" from "A1+" while the new long-term rating was "A+" from "AA-".
It said the ratings reflected the low expectation of investment risk. Capacity for the timely repayment of interest and principal was considered strong.
"This rating action follows the weakening financial profile during the past year, which is clearly borne out in deteriorating trends in key financial measures," IBCA said.
No major near-term recovery in M&R's financial profile was anticipated, it added.
